documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported strong operational performance for FY26, achieving its highest ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT (112% of installed capacity). The company recorded a Gross Refining Margin (GRM) of $9.28 per barrel for FY26 and $13.75 per barrel for Q4 FY26. Total dividend declared for FY26 reached INR 62 per share, including an interim dividend of INR 8 and a final dividend of INR 54 per share. CPCL has commenced execution of its Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project (INR 1,600 crores) and retail outlet expansion (INR 400 crores). Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported full-year FY25 crude throughput of 10.45 MMT (99.5% capacity utilization) and Q4 throughput of 2.974 MMT (113% capacity utilization).

guidance.claim: CPCL expects to maintain its business momentum in the new financial year.
guidance.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects routine maintenance capex to remain around INR 500 crores annually.
guidance.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

guidance.claim: CPCL expects normal maintenance and regular CAPEX to be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
guidance.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

guidance.claim: CPCL could add another Rs. 400 to Rs. 500 crores annually for the next two years if the LOBS project gets approved.
guidance.quote: And with this project, another Rs. 400 to Rs. 500 crores you can add for each of the year.

guidance.claim: CPCL forecasts maintenance CAPEX for the next year to be in the Rs. 200-250 crore range.
guidance.quote: The maintenance CAPEX will be at around Rs. 200-250 crore range and depending on value added projects approvals, the actual will be a little different.

demand_outlook.claim: CPCL achieved its highest ever annual LPG production of 447 TMT.
demand_outlook.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24.

demand_outlook.claim: CPCL sells around 90% of its products, primarily HSD and MS, to Indian Oil under a long-term RTP agreement.
demand_outlook.quote: No, our agreement, as you would be aware, close to about 90% of our product, mostly HSD, MS, goes to Indian Oil.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a clear shortfall in Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market where production is less than demand.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The MS shortfall in the southern market is approximately 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the southern market for other petroleum products is mostly aligned with national growth projections.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL incurred INR 856 crores in capex during FY26 compared to INR 673 crores in FY25.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project involves an investment of INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL's retail outlet project involves a capex of INR 400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The combined INR 2,000 crores capex across LOBS and retail projects will be spent over 2 to 3 years.
capex_expansion.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The new LOBS project will add 250 KTPA of Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

capex_expansion.claim: The Cauvery Basin Refinery capital cost was revised to Rs. 36,354 crores under a 25:75 equity joint venture between CPCL and IOCL.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The Cauvery Basin Refinery JV is currently planned with a 2:1 debt-to-equity structure.
capex_expansion.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL's average gross refining margin for FY26 stood at $9.28 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: Average gross refining margin for the period April to March '26 is US$9.28 per barrel (April to March 2025: US$ 4.22 per barrel).

margins_costs.claim: Gross refining margin for Q4 FY26 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Core GRM for Q4 FY26 was $10.3 per barrel.
Niche products account for 7% to 8% of sales volumes and contribute approximately 15% of CPCL's margins.
margins_costs.quote: About 7% to 8% constitutes these kinds of niche products. And this 7%–8% is currently contributing around 15% of my margins.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year GRM for FY25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in FY24 and the Singapore benchmark of $3.79 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL recorded a GRM of $6.22 per barrel in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for Q4 FY25 stood at $0.66 per barrel or Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL incurred an overall annual inventory loss of $0.06 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 40 crores for FY25.
margins_costs.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved its highest ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in Q4 FY26 was 2.93 MMT, operating at 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL reached record annual production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel (HSD) and 1.318 MMT for petrol (MS).
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS, an impressive testament of the refinery's outstanding operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: Distillate yield reached a record high of 79.1% during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity for pharma-grade Hexane was doubled from 30 to 60.
orders_capacity.quote: It was 30, now the capacity is 60.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved full-year crude throughput of 10.45 MMT (99.5% utilization) and Q4 throughput of 2.974 MMT (113% utilization).
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year and if you take that into consideration , you will find that this performance is quite comparable to the previous year's performance where CPCL clocked 111% capacity utilization and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: High sulfur crude accounted for almost 64% to 65% of CPCL's crude processing during FY25.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we have processed almost 64% - 65% of high sulfur.

orders_capacity.claim: RLNG consumption increased to 527 TMT in FY25 from 441 TMT in FY24.
orders_capacity.quote: RLNG consumption during the year FY 2024-25, was 527 TMT as against 441 TMT in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL's net debt to equity ratio stands at 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross borrowings stood at INR 1,900 crores while net borrowings were INR 973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CPCL recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share, bringing total dividend for FY26 to INR 62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: Absolute debt level stood at Rs. 3,100 crores as on March 31, 2025, compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share (50% of face value) for FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt to equity ratio was 0.39 as of March 31, 2025, compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth reached Rs. 7,939 crores as of March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forex loss was approximately INR 200 crores in Q4 FY26 and INR 350 crores for the full year.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility pose operational challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Middle East crude supplies faced a short-term disruption of 30% to 40%.
risks_headwinds.quote: What has impacted is that maybe 30% to 40% was affected over a very short period, but all have assured us that depending on the situation, they will make up all the cargoes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Refinery crude unit 1, which caters to lubes, is scheduled for maintenance around August-September 2025.
risks_headwinds.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude oil prices presents an ongoing business challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects significant commissioning of retail outlets during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL expects its ongoing secondary unit debottlenecking study to be completed in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

management_commitments.claim: Execution of the INR 2,000 crore LOBS and retail expansion projects will take place over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL projects normal maintenance and regular CAPEX of around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: Refinery crude unit 1 catering to lubes will enter scheduled maintenance around August-September 2025.
management_commitments.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
